content.title: 3 Services Stocks That Fall Short
content.summary: Business services providers use their specialized expertise to help enterprises streamline operations and cut costs. Still, investors are uneasy as firms face challenges from AI-driven disruptors and tightening corporate budgets. These doubts have certainly contributed to services stocks’ recent underperformance - over the past six months, the industry’s 6.1% gain has fallen behind the S&P 500’s 16.3% rise.
